patch.value: Calibrate future task durations from verified observed episodes
Compare planned effort at verified start with elapsed completion history for an explicitly selected task class; return an empirical sampled distribution without replacing estimates.
Canceled, reopened and incomplete histories are disclosed; fewer than the declared sample minimum refuses calibration; a fixed corpus yields reproducible quantiles and sample counts.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap recheck: CLI source has no observed task-duration calibration; its calibration APIs concern emitted-byte budgets. Existing gantt uncertainty consumes declared point/uniform/triangular effort; pm-brief summarizeMomentum reports throughput and closed_at cycle-time summaries. This feature reads verified lifecycle episodes and compares elapsed calendar minutes with planned minutes at start. It supplies explicit empirical scenario inputs, makes no causal productivity claim, and never replaces estimates. New command has no import, sync, journal, claim, outbox or mutation path; existing export remains read-only. Model-based tests will exercise seeded SDK lifecycle histories and preservation of native state in a non-git tracker.
